source: json-block.md Notes (server pretty-prints). The gallery writes the nested data object on one line, which is not the spec's pretty-print
notes: pretty-print rules: 2-space indent, `"key": value`, one member per line, empty `{}`/`[]`, keys in the order given (fixture keys are alphabetical so a language that sorts keys agrees), no \u escapes for < > & (the output is HTML-escaped afterwards), ASCII only
